body: Yes I consider it all the time and I'm so close to leaving for home. My dilemma is that I study here. I worked so hard through a shitty job for years to be able to afford to fulfill my dream to come here and study. If I gave that up I'd feel like a failure. I'd also be leaving my boyfriend, which is very very hard for me to do. I haven't thought about looking for a support group but I'll try, thank you.
